meta.name: Ensure RAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater
meta.description: Ensure RAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater

evaluators.description: alicloud_ram_account_password_policy.minimum_password_length must be 14 or more. A null value never satisfies a numeric comparison, so a policy that omits the attribute fails; the provider default is below 14 and fails too.
